author: Inside Edition
description: Reeva Gupta shares the story of a plane crash she survived that killed her mother, Roma Gupta, and the pilot. Reeva bought a flight lesson for her mom as a Christmas gift from Groupon. March 5, 2023 was the day of their flight. While in the air, Reeva noticed smoke and alerted the pilot. The smoke quickly turned into flames, and the last thing she remembers is her mother telling her to get out of the plane. She shares her story with Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: Over Half Of Woman's Body Burned In Plane Crash That Killed Her Mother
